hickory.facts: Eleven cabins; separately reservable slips. Cabin11 excludes pets. General minimum two nights; weekends require Friday and Saturday; Memorial Day, July4 and Labor Day require three nights. Payment policy distinguishes reservation payment from guest/slip/pet adjustments at check-in. Reservations use phone or online, while email can be an inquiry.
